body:
Plan, rules and numbers: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2.md (read "How a section is bound" first). Worktree wf-docs2, branch docs/pass2; DOCS_COMMON.md applies. Per-section list: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2/out-before/binding-sections.md.

Rules in short: bind claims, not mentions. For each target section, cite the code its claims depend on: `pass2/dsdef.sh <file>#<Symbol> [stable|api]` prints the id (idempotent, writes `//ds:def` in this repo's style), then link the name in the sentence: [`Name`](ds:block?id=<id>). Defaults and limits cite their const. Pitfalls that state library or driver behaviour cite the code (or the test) that makes it true. Snippet-synced Go blocks stay with `task docs:snippets`; bind the prose around them. Only `//ds:def` lines may change in library files. Never run `ds scan`, `ds ack` or `ds refresh` (the coordinator scans and commits `.ds/` once at the end); `ds check` must stay at 0 errors.

Owns: `docs/admin/`, `docs/choosing/`; examples: admin, admin-alerts, admin-audit, admin-bulk, admin-cli, admin-inspect, admin-reset-fork, admin-routes, admin-tenants, admin-ui, cli-tour.

Binding now: 15 pages, 87 sections describe library code (Try it and Related excluded), 1 bound.

## Bind (one line per page: target sections, bound now, the unbound ones)

- [ ] `docs/admin/alerts.md` (5 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Step 1: set thresholds and an alerter; Step 2: run it; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/admin/audit-and-traces.md` (5 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Audit every write action; Link each run to its trace; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/admin/cli.md` (6 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Connect; Preview before you act; Script with it; Embed it in your binary; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/admin/http-api.md` (8 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Step 1: say who may do what; Step 2: mount the handler; Routes; Step 3: handle the error codes; What is left out; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/admin/operations.md` (13 target, 1 bound): (top); Behind a wrapper, ask what is underneath; Step 2: find runs; Step 3: act on runs; Act on many runs at once; Step 4: pause and resume; Queue depth and oldest wait; Schedules; Run-end history for charts; Nodes and health; Captured output; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/admin/tenants.md` (6 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Step 1: say which tenant each caller sees; Step 2: mount the handler with the scope; What a scoped caller sees; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/admin/ui.md` (6 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Step 1: accept the session cookie in Identify; Step 2: mount the handler; What it is safe against; The screens; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/README.md` (3 target, 0 bound): (top); Quick answers; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/app-types.md` (4 target, 0 bound): The table; Tests; If X, then Y; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/drivers.md` (7 target, 0 bound): (top); Memory, SQL, Redis or Hatchet; What Hatchet refuses; If X, then Y; Hybrid, failover, regional, cutover or pools; If X, then Y for wrappers; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/methods.md` (9 target, 0 bound): Enqueue, EnqueueTx or the outbox; Workflow.Cron or Schedule; A batch or plain enqueues; Idempotency key, unique or debounce; Concurrency limit or rate limit; RunAt, a sleep step or a schedule; Retry, snooze or release; Max, Permanent, NoRetryOn or FailOn; OnFailure, OnRunFinished or a batch callback
- [ ] `docs/choosing/operations.md` (3 target, 0 bound): Archive tables, the WithArchive hook or the run recorder; StartWhen or a readiness probe; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/schedules.md` (5 target, 0 bound): (top); Workflow.Cron, Schedule, LocalCron, hybrid or RunAt; Who fires a tick: the tick row, leader election or a scheduler node; Missed and stale ticks: misfire, LatestOnly or overlap; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/shapes.md` (3 target, 0 bound): Job, workflow, chain, children or batch; Schedule, object, state machine, saga or events; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/choosing/waiting.md` (4 target, 0 bound): Wait for time: sleep step, SleepUntil, RunAt or snooze; Wait for the world: signals, approvals, polls and promises; If X, then Y; Pitfalls

## Gaps to close

- [ ] admin: the `Action*` consts (24) and `Op*` consts (17), `DefaultMetricsBucket`, `DefaultMetricsDedupe`, `DefaultMetricsKeep`, `DefaultMetricsPoints`, `DefaultMetricsWindow`, `DefaultSchedulesLimit`, `MaxSchedulesLimit` are named by no page: cite the const blocks (`ds def <file>:<start>-<end>`) from the Authorizer and route tables, and cite each default where a page states its value.
- [ ] docs/choosing/ (new to this batch): every per-driver capability or refusal claim cites the driver capability defs W3 makes (or makes them with `dsdef.sh`, idempotent).

## Done when

- [ ] `python3 tools/binding.py` + `tools/batches.py` (see pass2.md) show every target section of this batch bound, or the report names the section and why it states no claim worth binding.
- [ ] `ds check` 0 errors; `task docs:wrap docs:links docs:snippets docs:words` pass; `go test -race` of every example touched.
- [ ] Report wf-context/reports/docs-p2-w5.md with before/after binding counts, defs added (id, file), Shared-file lines, Library bugs, DONE.
